# Curated diagnostic repair replay

This is an existing rejected corpus example, selected to evaluate diagnostic
clarity. It is not a new first-pass model attempt or an independent benchmark.
The current Codex assistant has already read the accepted workaround; later
repair success must not be attributed solely to the changed diagnostic.
Task: inspect the rejection, improve its actionable information, then check a
supported repair and retain a false repair as a rejection regression where
applicable. The complete prior conversation and repository are available.
The exact model deployment identifier and sampling parameters are unavailable.
